title: 第17章 暴富考虑筑基第18章 逆天丹方前进的方向
slug: 修真废柴我的系统有点猛
lines: “多亏刚刚那位突然出现的黑衣前辈……””
柳如媚简单解释了几句，随即目光一寒，
看向了瘫软在地、目睹了乌环被杀、早已吓得魂飞魄散的匪首孙霸刀！
“姚师叔，此人交给我！”
柳如媚提剑上前，声音冰冷。
孙霸刀此刻哪里还有半分凶悍？
他看着柳如媚杀气腾腾地走来，吓得屁滚尿流，连滚带爬地想逃。
噗！
一抹剑光带起一颗惊恐的头颅飞起！
柳如媚和白小巧开始收敛唐二的尸身，查看孟虎的伤势，此刻手臂折断重伤昏迷但尚有气息。
发现孟虎并无生命危险，便开始打扫战场。
随后众人在寨子中间的主帐内，
发现两个檀木做的箱子，里面竟然满满的装着下品和中品灵石。
晨曦微照，荒土村一众村民千恩万谢地送别了阴阳宗的仙师。
灵舟承载着昏迷的孟虎、唐二的尸身以及三个疲惫的活人，
在破晓的天光中划过一道青虹，朝着阴阳宗的方向疾驰而去。
灵舟舱内气氛沉重。
白小巧照顾着昏死的孟虎，
柳如媚则看着唐二冰冷的尸体，美眸含悲。
姚德龙沉默地坐在角落，闭目调息，一副惊魂未定、元气大损的模样。
半途，孟虎终于在一阵钻心剧痛中悠悠转醒。
断臂处传来的撕裂感和燃血丹的强烈反噬，让他浑身抽搐，额头冷汗涔涔。
他艰难地睁开眼，模糊的视线扫过舱内，看到柳如媚、白小巧，
最后落在角落里似乎毫发无损、只是脸色苍白的姚德龙身上。
一股难以言喻的怒火和不平衡瞬间冲垮了剧痛！
他嘶哑着嗓子，如同受伤的野兽；
“嗬…嗬…那老废物……为何……为何他没事？！”
声音充满了刻骨的恨意和不甘。
柳如媚眉头紧蹙，虽然对孟虎之前的跋扈也有不满，但此刻看他惨状，
还是耐着性子将昨夜那位神秘黑袍剑修出手斩杀乌环、救下众人，
以及姚德龙在外围“拦截”
漏网之鱼的事情简述了一遍。
“黑袍……剑修？”
孟虎喘息着，眼中阴晴不定。
他昏迷之前好像是看到一抹剑光。
至于姚德龙拦截马匪？他半个字都不信！
这老东西定然是躲在哪个犄角旮旯瑟瑟发抖，等尘埃落定才跑出来捡便宜！
看着姚德龙那副“虚弱”
的样子，孟虎只觉得无比的刺眼和恶心，心中的恨意更深了一层。
回到阴阳宗，柳如媚立刻安排人将重伤的孟虎送往丹霞峰救治，断臂能否续接尚是未知。
她又亲自将唐二的遗体送回土垚峰，
content_en:
"Thanks to the senior in black who suddenly appeared just now..."
Liu Rumei briefly explained a few words, then her eyes turned cold.
He looked at the bandit leader Sun Ba Dao who was paralyzed on the ground and had witnessed Wu Huan being killed. He was already frightened out of his mind!
"Uncle Yao, leave this person to me! "
Liu Rumei stepped forward with her sword in hand, her voice cold.
How can Sun Badao still be half fierce at this moment?
When he saw Liu Rumei approaching with murderous intent, he was so frightened that he peeed and crawled to the ground to escape.
Poof!
A flash of sword light caused a frightened head to fly up!
Liu Rumei and Bai Xiaoqiao began to collect Tang Er's body and check Meng Hu's injuries. At this moment, his arm was broken and he was seriously injured, but he was unconscious but still breathing.
Finding that Meng Hu's life was not in danger, he began to clean up the battlefield.
Then everyone was in the main tent in the middle of the village,
I found two boxes made of sandalwood, which were filled with low-grade and medium-grade spiritual stones.
The morning light shone slightly, and all the villagers in Huangtu Village bid farewell to the Immortal Master of the Yin Yang Sect with great gratitude.
The spirit boat carried the unconscious Meng Hu, Tang Er's body and three tired living people.
A blue rainbow flashed across the dawn sky, speeding towards the Yin Yang Sect.
The atmosphere in the spirit boat cabin was heavy.
Bai Xiaoqiao took care of the unconscious Meng Hu.
Liu Rumei looked at Tang Er's cold corpse with sadness in her beautiful eyes.
Yao Delong sat silently in the corner, closing his eyes and regulating his breath, looking as if he was in shock and greatly weakened.
Halfway through, Meng Hu finally woke up with a burst of heartbreaking pain.
The tearing feeling coming from the broken arm and the strong backlash from the Burning Blood Pill made his whole body twitch and sweat dripped from his forehead.
He opened his eyes with difficulty, his blurry vision swept across the cabin, and saw Liu Rumei and Bai Xiaoqiao,
Finally, it fell on Yao Delong, who seemed to be unscathed but pale in the corner.
An unspeakable anger and imbalance instantly overcame the severe pain!
He croaked like a wounded beast;
“Ho…ho…that old loser…why…why is he okay? ! "
The voice was full of deep-seated hatred and unwillingness.
Liu Rumei frowned. Although she was dissatisfied with Meng Hu's previous domineering behavior, looking at his miserable state now,
Still being patient, the mysterious black-robed swordsman from last night killed Wu Huan and saved everyone.
And Yao Delong "intercepted" from the outside
The incident that slipped through the net was briefly described.
"Black robe... sword cultivator? "
Meng Hu gasped, his eyes uncertain.
He seemed to have seen a flash of sword light before he fell unconscious.
As for Yao Delong intercepting the horse bandit? He didn't believe a word of it!
This old guy must be hiding in some nook and cranny, shivering, waiting for the dust to settle before running out to take advantage!
Looking at Yao Delong's "weakness"
Meng Hu felt extremely dazzling and disgusting, and the hatred in his heart deepened.
Returning to the Yin Yang Sect, Liu Rumei immediately arranged for people to send the seriously injured Meng Hu to Danxia Peak for treatment. It was still unknown whether the broken arm could be repaired.
She personally sent Tang Er's body back to Tuyao Peak.
